rec.question: Four sources of light each provide light of a single colour: red, blue, green and yellow. The angle of refraction for a beam of yellow light, for a particular angle of incidence at the interface of two media, is 90°. If the yellow source is replaced by the other colours without changing the angle of incidence,
rec.option1: the beam of red light would undergo total internal reflection.
rec.option2: the beam of red light would bend towards the normal while it gets refracted through the second medium.
rec.option3: the beam of blue light would undergo total internal reflection.
rec.option4: the beam of green light would bend away from the normal as it gets refracted through the second medium.
rec.correct_option: the beam of blue light would undergo total internal reflection.

rec.option1: act as a convex lens only for the objects that lie on its curved side.
rec.option2: act as a concave lens for the objects that lie on its curved side.
rec.option3: act as a convex lens irrespective of the side on which the object lies.
rec.option4: act as a concave lens irrespective of the side on which the object lies.
rec.correct_option: act as a convex lens irrespective of the side on which the object lies.

rec.option3: dispersion of light by water molecules during the formation of a rainbow.
rec.option4: scattering of light by the particles of air.
rec.correct_option: total internal reflection of light in air during a mirage.

(i) the apparent depth of the points close to the edge is nearer the surface of the water compared to the points away from the edge.
(ii) the angle subtended by the image of the object at the eye is smaller than the actual angle subtended by the object in air.
(iii) some of the points of the object far away from the edge may not be visible because of total internal reflection.
(iv) water in a trough acts as a lens and magnifies the object.
Choose the correct option.
